articles.headline: S&P 500 pulls within 1.2% of its all-time high even as majority of its stocks fell
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: On Tuesday, Wall Street stocks rose as artificial intelligence-related equities led the market higher. The S&P 500 increased by 0.6% to near its all-time high, the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 25 points or less than 0.1%, and the Nasdaq composite climbed 1.2%, despite a majority of S&P 500 stocks falling. Broadcom rose 4.2% after announcing a $63 billion financing deal involving Anthropic and its XPU AI accelerators. Nvidia gained 0.8%, and CoreWeave jumped 8.5%. General Motors climbed 5.6% after announcing it will move its stock listing from the New York Stock Exchange to the Nasdaq. JetBlue Airways rose 20.3% despite a larger summer loss, with CEO Joanna Geraghty stating the airline expects to return to sustained operating profits next year and earn at least $1 per share in 2028. Royal Caribbean Group increased by 5.5% after reporting stronger summer profit and raising its full-year forecast. Conversely, Boeing dropped 10.2% and Hilton Worldwide Holdings fell 2.6% due to weaker-than-expected results, with Hilton citing increased impacts from the Middle East. Sherwin-Williams declined 1.9% as high mortgage rates and inflation pressured demand, with CEO Heidi Petz noting muted demand expectations through 2027. U. S. consumer confidence improved in October. Treasury yields held relatively steady ahead of the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision, with the 10-year Treasury yield slipping to 4.99% from 5.00%. Brent crude oil prices fell 1.2% to $109.41 per barrel.
articles.summary_zh: 周二，华尔街股市上涨，人工智能板块引领大盘走高。 标普500指数上涨0.6%，接近其历史最高点；道琼斯工业平均指数上涨25点或不到0.1%；纳斯达克综合指数上涨1.2%，尽管标普500指数中多数股票下跌。 Broadcom在宣布一项$63 billion的融资交易后股价上涨4.2%，该交易旨在帮助Anthropic获得Broadcom的XPU人工智能加速器和网络解决方案。 Nvidia上涨0.8%，CoreWeave跃升8.5%。 General Motors上涨5.6%，该公司宣布将其股票从纽约证券交易所转至纳斯达克上市。 JetBlue Airways尽管公布了更大的夏季亏损，但股价仍上涨20.3%，首席执行官Joanna Geraghty表示公司预计明年恢复持续运营利润，并在2028年实现每股至少$1的收益。 Royal Caribbean Group上涨5.5%，因其夏季利润好于预期并上调了全年利润预测。 相比之下，Boeing下跌10.2%，Hilton Worldwide Holdings因夏季营收弱于预期下跌2.6%，并预计中东地区的影响将增加。 Sherwin-Williams下跌1.9%，首席执行官Heidi Petz指出客户情绪和指标指向需求持续低迷至2027年。 美国10月消费者信心有所改善。 在美联储公布利率决定前，美国国债收益率保持相对稳定，10世纪国债收益率从周一晚间的5.00%小幅降至4.99%。 布伦特原油价格下跌1.2%，至每桶$109.41。

articles.headline: Tesla Gains Another 4% as ARK Restates $4,400 Robotaxi Target and Musk Teases “A Storm of Cybercabs”
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: Tesla shares rose 4%, adding to a previous gain driven by a Barclays upgrade and ARK Invest restating its $4,400 base-case price target for 2031. Elon Musk posted 'A Storm of Cybercabs' on X. Barclays analyst Dan Levy upgraded Tesla to Overweight and raised his price target to $450 from $370, noting that an anticipated merger with SpaceX has become a key part of the bull case, though no terms have been set and both companies have formed special committees. ARK Invest's model, updated October 19, attributes roughly 80% of Tesla's 2031 enterprise value to robotaxis, projecting about 8.1 million robotaxis to generate $733 billion of net ride-hail revenue that year. Consensus Wall Street targets sit much lower, with the consensus target climbing to $411 and the highest at $600. Tesla traded at 183 times forward earnings at Monday's close, pushing closer to 190 times after the gain, while consensus estimates project normalized earnings per share to rise from $1.66 in 2025 to $3.20 in 2028. Meanwhile, Tesla stated that its Texas Cybercab factory can currently build robotaxis faster than it can deploy them into service, with a Dallas launch scheduled for November and initial robotaxi revenue expected in 2027.
articles.summary_zh: Tesla股价上涨4%，延续了此前因Barclays上调评级以及ARK Invest重申其2031年$4,400基本目标价而带来的涨幅。 Elon Musk在X上发文称“Cybercabs风暴”。 Barclays分析师Dan Levy将Tesla评级上调至增持，并将目标价从$370上调至$450，指出预期中的SpaceX合并案现在是看好Tesla的关键部分，尽管尚未设定条款且双方均已成立特别委员会。 ARK Invest于10月19日更新的模型将Tesla 2031年企业价值的大约80%归因于自动驾驶出租车，预计当年约有810万辆自动驾驶出租车产生$733 billion的净网约车收入。 华尔街的其他共识目标价要低得多，共识目标价升至$411，最高为$600。 周一收盘时，Tesla的远期市盈率达到183倍，上涨后更加接近190倍，而共识估计显示每股正常化收益预计将从2025年的$1.66上升到2028年的$3.20。 同时，Tesla表示其得克萨斯州Cybercab工厂目前的机器人出租车建造速度快于投入运营的速度，达拉斯发布会定于11月举行，首批真正的自动驾驶出租车收入预计在2027年实现。

articles.headline: How To Employ Nasdaq Options Data In Gauging Tech Sector Risk Sentiment
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: Active traders and investors examine options price action, volume, and open interest to gauge future price trajectories and volatility, particularly in the volatile technology sector. For technology and semiconductor stocks driven by artificial intelligence demand, Nasdaq-100 Index Options and Nasdaq-100 Micro Index Options serve as key tools for trading or hedging. The Micro Index Options track the Nasdaq-100 Micro Index at 1/100th of the full NDX value with a $100 multiplier, creating a notional exposure of $29,000 at an index value of around 290 to accommodate retail traders. Analyzing the put/call ratio of NDX and XND indicates market sentiment, where a high ratio shows bearish bias and anxiety, while a low ratio reflects a bullish stance and risk appetite. Implied volatility measures option premiums and indicates potential near-term price swings. Prior to second-quarter high-tech earnings, NDX and XND experienced implied volatility surges due to concerns over U. S. AI model monetization compared to Chinese rivals. According to a Seeking Alpha report, investors utilized short-dated options skewed heavily toward puts for portfolio protection, creating volatility spikes that pushed the Volatility Index higher. Options skew measures pricing differences between out-of-the-money puts and calls, with a steep skew indicating heightened risk aversion and bearish sentiment.
articles.summary_zh: 活跃的交易者和投资者通过研究期权的价格走势、成交量和未平仓合约来评估未来的价格轨迹和波动性，特别是针对波动较大的科技板块。 对于受人工智能需求驱动的科技和半导体股票，纳斯达克100指数期权和纳斯达克100微型指数期权是交易或对冲的关键工具。 微型指数期权追踪纳斯达克100微型指数，其价值固定为完整NDX价值的1/100（1%），并带有$100的乘数，在指数约为290时提供$29,000的名义敞口，以方便散户参与。 分析NDX和XND的看跌/看涨比率可以显示市场情绪，高比率表明看跌偏向和焦虑，而低比率反映看涨立场和风险偏好。 隐含波动率衡量期权溢价，并指示近期可能的日价格波动。 在第二季度高科技企业财报发布前，由于对美国AI模型商业化与中国竞争对手相比存在水分的看法，NDX和XND的隐含波动率出现激增。 根据Seeking Alpha的一份报告，投资者为了投资组合保护，大量建仓偏向看跌期权的短期NDX/XND期权，造成了显著的波动率飙升，并迫使更广泛市场的波动率指数上升。 期权偏斜衡量虚值看跌期权和看涨期权之间的定价差异，陡峭的偏斜表明市场风险厌恶情绪加剧以及更加看跌的情绪。

articles.headline: US stocks hold steady as the countdown ticks to a Federal Reserve decision on interest rates
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: U. S. stocks drifted on Wednesday ahead of the Federal Reserve's interest rate announcement. The S&P 500 rose 0.2% to near its all-time high, the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 149 points or 0.3%, and the Nasdaq composite remained mostly unchanged. Wall Street widely expects the Federal Reserve to leave the federal funds rate unchanged after raising it last month for the first time in three years, though attention remains on whether Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh will hint at future moves. GE HealthCare Technologies jumped 7.2% after exceeding summer profit and revenue expectations while raising its full-year forecasts. Etsy climbed 5.3% following strong quarterly profit, with CEO Kruti Patel Goyal noting active buyer growth from prior-year levels for the first time in two years. South Korea's SK Hynix soared 10.9% in Seoul after reporting that AI chip demand continues to outpace supply through 2030, which boosted AI-related stocks including Micron Technology, up 4.7%. Wendy's surged 15.1% to $7.09 after Trian Fund Management, led by Nelson Peltz, offered to buy the chain for $7.35 per share in cash. Conversely, Boston Scientific fell 5% despite a milder profit drop, and Robinhood Markets sank 4.2% following weaker quarterly profit and revenue. The 10-year Treasury yield rose to 5.03% from 4.99%, driven by rising oil prices amid Middle East and global energy uncertainties. Brent crude oil climbed 2.7% to $112.39 per barrel. Abroad, South Korea's Kospi jumped 6.6%, Japan's Nikkei 225 rose 1.1%, and France's CAC 40 rose 0.1%.
articles.summary_zh: 美国股市周三在美联储公布利率决议前呈窄幅震荡。 标普500指数上涨0.2%，接近本月早些时候创下的历史高点；道琼斯工业平均指数上涨149点或0.3%；纳斯达克综合指数基本持平。 华尔街普遍预计美联储在上个月三年来首次加息后将维持联邦基金利率不变，焦点在于美联储主席Kevin Warsh是否会对未来的动向给出暗示。 GE HealthCare Technologies在公布超出预期的夏季利润和营收并上调全年预测后，股价大涨7.2%。 Etsy因季度利润大幅超预期而攀升5.3%，首席执行官Kruti Patel Goyal指出，活跃买家数量两年来首次实现同比增长。 韩国SK Hynix在首尔飙升10.9%，此前该公司公布其人工智能芯片需求将持续超过供应直到2030年，这提振了包括上涨4.7%的Micron Technology在内的人工智能股票。 Wendy's飙升15.1%至$7.09，此前由Nelson Peltz运营的Trian Fund Management提出以每股$7.35的现金收购该连锁店。 相反，Boston Scientific尽管利润降幅较预期温和但仍下跌5%，Robinhood Markets因季度利润和营收弱于预期下跌4.2%。 受中东及全球能源局势不确定性推动油价上涨的影响，10年期美国国债收益率从4.99%升至5.03%。 布伦特原油价格上涨2.7%，至每桶$112.39。 海外市场方面，韩国综合股价指数大涨6.6%，日本日经225指数上涨1.1%，法国CAC 40指数上涨0.1%。

articles.headline: Stock Market Today: Stock Market News And Analysis
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average and other major stock indexes rose modestly on Wednesday as Wall Street awaited the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision, with analysts anticipating no change in interest rates.
articles.summary_zh: 道琼斯工业平均指数和其他主要股指周三微幅上涨，当时华尔街正等待美联储的利率决定，分析师预计利率将保持不变。

articles.headline: NVIDIA, AMD and Broadcom May Invest in Meta, Their Own Biggest Customer. What That Signals
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: Meta Platforms is raising equity through a stock offering to fund its AI spending, and its chip suppliers NVIDIA, AMD, and Broadcom may participate. Broadcom has a custom AI chip deal with Meta running through 2029, and AMD's agreement includes a warrant aligning Meta's incentives with its success. In the third quarter, Meta reported revenue of $64.60 billion, up 26.07%, while GAAP EPS reached $3.83, impacted by a $9.89 billion litigation charge. Capex reached $34.906 billion, driving free cash flow to -$2.12 billion. Ad pricing rose 14%, impressions grew 10%, and daily users reached 3.64 billion. Meta expects 2026 capex to be between $135 billion and $145 billion, compared to $72.215 billion in 2025.
articles.summary_zh: Meta Platforms正在通过股票发行筹集资金以资助其人工智能支出，其芯片供应商NVIDIA、AMD和Broadcom可能会参与其中。 Broadcom与Meta的定制人工智能芯片协议将持续到2029年，AMD的协议则包含一项将Meta利益与其成功挂钩的认股权证。 在第三季度，Meta报告营收为$64.60 billion，增长26.07%，GAAP每股收益为$3.83，受到$9.89 billion诉讼费用的影响。 资本支出达到$34.906 billion，导致自由现金流降至-$2.12 billion。 广告定价上涨14%，展示量增长10%，日活跃用户达到3.64 billion。 Meta预计2026年资本支出在$135 billion到$145 billion之间，而2025年为$72.215 billion。

articles.headline: AMD, Broadcom, and Micron stocks lead chip sector higher for third day in a row
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: Semiconductor stocks edged higher on Wednesday, extending gains for the PHLX Semiconductor Index for a third consecutive day. NVIDIA shares rose nearly 1% before trimming gains, while AMD and Broadcom also edged higher. The sector moved upward following a sevenfold profit increase reported by South Korean memory maker SK Hynix last quarter. SK Hynix projected a memory supply shortage heading into 2030 due to surging AI inference and the adoption of physical AI applications. Peer companies Micron Technology and Samsung Electronics jumped 4% and 9% respectively, and equipment makers Applied Materials and Lam Research rose over 2%. Meanwhile, Seagate shares declined despite beating revenue and profit estimates, as shipped data storage volume remained flat and investors took profits after a 140% year-to-date surge.
articles.summary_zh: 周三半导体股票小幅走高，费城半导体指数连续第三天上涨。 NVIDIA股价上涨近1%后回吐部分涨幅，AMD和Broadcom也小幅走高。 此前，韩国存储制造商SK Hynix公布上一季度利润增长七倍。 SK Hynix预测，随着人工智能推理激增以及应用向物理人工智能转变，2020年代末期将出现存储供应短缺。 同行业公司Micron Technology和Samsung Electronics分别上涨4%和9%，设备制造商Applied Materials和Lam Research涨幅超过2%。 同时，尽管Seagate的营收和利润超出预期，但由于出货的数据存储量持平且投资者在股价年内飙升140%后进行获利回吐，其股价出现下跌。

articles.headline: バイオジェンが決算 スピンラザとサイフォブレが好調 ただ株価は下げに転じている＝米国株個別(株探ニュース)
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: Biogen announced its third-quarter financial results before the market opened, reporting that both earnings per share and revenue exceeded expectations. Adjusted earnings per share reached 2.62 dollars, and revenue rose 11% to 2.80 billion dollars, driven by strong performances from Spinraza and Zurzuvae. The company also revised its full-year adjusted earnings per share guidance to between 12.20 dollars and 13.00 dollars, compared to the previous range of 12.00 dollars and 13.00 dollars, while projecting mid-single-digit revenue growth and total research, development, and selling expenses of approximately 4.95 billion dollars. Despite the positive results and an initial rise, Biogen's stock price turned downward after early buying subsided.
articles.summary_zh: 渤健在开盘前公布了第三季度财报，报告显示每股收益和营收均超出预期。 在Spinraza和Zurzuvae表现强劲的推动下，调整后每股收益达到2.62ドル，营收增长11%至2.80ビル・ドール。 公司还将全年调整后每股收益预期从先前的12.00ドル至13.00ドル上调至12.20ドル至13.00ドル，同时预计营收将实现中个位数增长，研发及销售费用总计约为4.95ビル・ドール。 尽管业绩向好且股价盘初上涨，但在买盘消退后，渤健股价转为下跌。

articles.headline: 視る日経！ニュースNEXT▼１日の経済・投資・マーケット情報を深掘り、明日に生かす！
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: News NEXT is an economic news program that delivers business and market information utilizing the resources of the Nikkei group, including the Nikkei Shimbun, Nikkei BP, and the Financial Times. Aimed at business professionals and investors, the one-hour broadcast provides analysis and information. The program features main anchor Hitomi Yagi, commentator Tatehiko Koyanagi, and announcer Akira Saito. Content includes special reports on prominent topics, daily news reviews from the Nikkei electronic edition, and daily access rankings.
articles.summary_zh: News NEXT是一档经济新闻节目，利用日本经济新闻、日经BP以及金融时报等日经集团的资源提供商业和市场信息。 该节目面向商务人士和投资者，提供为期一小时的分析与资讯。 节目由主主播八木瞳、评论员小柳建彦和主播斋藤阳主持。 内容包括对热门话题的专题报道、日经电子版的每日重要新闻回顾以及每日访问排行榜。

articles.headline: 【テクニカル】日経平均株価テクニカル分析－10日線を上回る続伸
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: The Nikkei Stock Average recorded a significant continued rebound with a strong opening. Although it faced upward hesitation above the 64,000 yen level, it finished above both the 10-day moving average of 63,837 yen and the Ichimoku Kinko Hyo conversion line of 63,587 yen on October 28, maintaining a strong recovery on a closing basis. The 9-day RSI rose from 26.5% to 46.5% on October 28. The 5-day moving average at 63,002 yen is expected to turn upward, and the downward slope of the 10-day moving average and conversion line is flattening. Upside targets include the psychological milestone of 65,000 yen, the 25-day moving average of 66,196 yen, the October 14 low of 67,533 yen, and 68,000 yen.
articles.summary_zh: 日经平均指数开盘走高，实现大幅连续反弹。 尽管在64000日元上方遭遇上行阻力，但截至10月28日，收盘价仍高于63837日元的10日移动平均线和63587日元的一目均衡表转换线，在收盘基础上保持了强劲的反弹走势。 9日RSI从10月28日的26.5%上升至46.5%。 位于63002日元的5日移动平均线预计将向上倾斜，10日移动平均线和转换线的下行斜率也变得缓和。 上方目标包括65000日元的心理关口、66196日元的25日移动平均线、10月14日的低点67533日元以及68000日元。

articles.headline: TOPIX入れ替え、売買需要9.6兆円 キオクシアは9748億円の買い
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 日本取引所グループは30日に東証株価指数（TOPIX）の構成銘柄入れ替えを実施する。 新基準として初めての定期入れ替えとなり、29日の取引終了時には指数に連動するパッシブ運用の機関投資家の売買が総額約9.6兆円発生する可能性がある。 指数連動ファンドは29日までに組み入れ比率の変動に合わせて持ち高を調整する必要がある。
articles.summary_zh: 日本交易所集团将于30日实施东证股价指数（TOPIX）的成分股调整。 这是采用新标准后的首次定期调整，在29日交易结束时，与该指数挂钩的被动投资机构可能会产生总额约9.6万亿日元的买卖交易。 挂钩指数的基金需要在29日之前根据纳入比例的变化调整持仓。

articles.headline: トヨタ系中堅5社､2社が今期下方修正 原料高｢今までにないレベル｣
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: トヨタ自動車系の中堅部品メーカー5社は28日に2026年4〜9月期の連結決算を発表し、27年3月期の純利益見通しは2社が下方修正した。 原料価格の高騰や競争環境が激しい中国事業に対する懸念が示された。 原料価格の高騰が各社の利益を直撃した一方で、エンジン用軸受けの大豊工業では4〜9月期の連結純利益が前年同期比2.4倍の20億円となった。
articles.summary_zh: 丰田汽车系的中坚零部件制造商5家于28日公布了2026年4至9月期的合并财报，其中2家向下修正了2027年3月期的净利润预期。 原料价格高涨以及竞争激烈的中国业务引发了各方的担忧。 原料价格的暴涨直接冲击了各家企业的利润，另一方面，发动机轴承制造商大丰工业4至9月期的合并净利润为20亿日元，达到去年同期的2.4倍。

articles.headline: 本日の【イチオシ決算】 アドテスト、東エレデバ、ＪＲ東海 (10月28日)(株探ニュース)
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 10月28日引け後に発表された決算・業績修正において、アドバンテストは27年3月期の連結最終利益を従来予想の6600億円から7415億円へ12.3％上方修正し、3期連続での過去最高益予想を上乗せした。 同時に1100万株または2800億円を上限とする自社株買いを発表した。 また、サンテック、東エレデバ、積化成、福島銀、ＪＲ東海も業績修正や配当増額を発表した。
articles.summary_zh: 在10月28日收盘后公布的财报及业绩修正中，爱测试将2027年3月期的合并最终利润从原先预测的6600亿日元向上修正至7415亿日元，增幅达12.3%，并进一步上调了连续3期创历史新高的利润预期。 同时，该公司宣布以1100万股或2800亿日元为上限进行股票回购。 此外，三特、东京电子Device、积水化成品工业、福岛银行、东海旅客铁道也公布了业绩修正或增加分红的决定。

articles.headline: アドバンテスト株3%高 米半導体指数の上昇で（28日の株式市場）
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 28日の東京株式市場で日経平均株価は続伸し、終値は前日比685円82銭高の6万3954円19銭だった。 前日の米半導体株高に加え、28日は半導体株の比重が大きい韓国総合株価指数（KOSPI）が大幅高となり、投資家心理が強気に傾いた。 半導体など人工知能（AI）関連銘柄に海外短期筋の買いが入り、日経平均の上げ幅は一時1000円を超えた。
articles.summary_zh: 在28日的东京股票市场上，日经平均股价继续上涨，收盘价较前一日上涨685日元82钱，报63954日元19钱。 继前一日美国半导体股走高之后，28日半导体股权重较大的韩国综合股价指数（KOSPI）大幅上涨，促使投资者心理倾向于乐观。 半导体等人工智能（AI）相关股票受到了海外短期资金的买入，日经平均指数的涨幅曾一度超过1000日元。

articles.headline: How Bond Yields Affect Stocks and Every Market in 2026
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Government bond yields set the price of money, serving as the starting point for valuing shares, property, and currencies. When yields rise, future company profits are worth less, and mortgages and corporate loans become more expensive. The US 10-year Treasury yield closed at 4.99% on 27 October 2026, after touching about 5.36% on 7 October, which was the highest level since 2002. Bonds are loans where buyers lend money to governments or companies in exchange for fixed coupons and repayment at maturity. Bond prices and yields move in opposite directions. Duration measures a bond's price sensitivity to yield changes, meaning long-term bonds lose more value when yields rise. Treasuries carry risks such as sharp price drops when yields rise and inflation eroding real values.
articles.summary_zh: 政府债券收益率设定了资金价格，并作为评估股票、财产和货币价值的起点。 当收益率上升时，未来公司利润的现值会减少，按揭贷款和企业贷款也会变得更加昂贵。 根据美国财政部数据，美国10年期国债收益率在2026年10月27日收于4.99%，此前在10月7日曾触及约5.36%的高位，为2002年以来的最高水平。 债券是买方向政府或公司出借资金以换取固定票息并在到期时还本的借贷工具。 债券价格与收益率呈反向变动。 久期衡量债券价格对收益率变化的敏感度，这意味着长期债券在收益率上升时会损失更多价值。 国债也存在风险，例如在收益率上升时价格大幅下跌，以及通货膨胀侵蚀其真实价值。

articles.headline: Gold's $4,000 Defense: State Street Still Sees $5,500 by Q1 2027, But Cuts Odds to 60%
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: International gold prices oscillated around the $4,000-an-ounce threshold. State Street Investment Management maintained its forecast that gold will recover to $4,750–$5,500 by the end of the first quarter of 2027, but cut the probability to 60% from 70%. Gold reached an all-time high of $5,595 an ounce on January 29, 2026, then corrected and hovered near $4,000 in late October, about 28% below the peak. State Street head of gold strategy Aakash Doshi noted that structural demand underpins the market, but Federal Reserve monetary policy uncertainty is rising. Gold fell 6.3% in September after a 25-basis-point rate hike, driving U. S. Treasury yields and the U. S. dollar higher. State Street sees a 35% chance gold stays between $4,000 and $4,750 over the next six to nine months. Despite price pullbacks, U. S. -listed gold ETFs attracted $11.7 billion in inflows in the third quarter, including $3.7 billion in September.
articles.summary_zh: 国际金价在每盎司4,000美元门槛附近反复震荡。 道富投资管理维持其预测，认为黄金将在2027年第一季度末回升至4750美元至5500美元之间，但将这一乐观情景的概率从70%下调至60%。 黄金曾在2026年1月29日创下每盎司5595美元的历史最高纪录，随后持续回调，10月下旬徘徊在4000美元附近，仍比1月峰值低约28%。 道富黄金策略主管阿卡什·多什及其团队指出，结构性需求仍然支撑着广义黄金市场，但美联储货币政策前景的不确定性正在迅速上升，并成为压制价格的主要变量。 在美联储9月加息25个基点后，黄金在9月单月下跌了6.3%，更高的利率预期推高了美国国债收益率并推动美元创下两个月新高。 道富认为黄金在未来六到九个月内保持在4000美元至4750美元区间的概率为35%。 尽管价格回调，美国上市的黄金交易所交易基金在第三季度吸引了$11.7 billion的资金流入，其中包括9月份单月流入的37亿美元。

articles.headline: Gold Price Analysis Today | Forex Gold Analysis | XAU/USD Analysis - October 26, 2026
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Gold traded around $3,996 on the morning of October 26, 2026, breaking below the $4,000 support level and closing down over 3.5% for the week. The Hormuz crisis pushed Brent crude above $117 to a four-year high, accelerating inflation and pressuring the Fed to hold rates. Spot gold closed at $3,995.81 an ounce. WTI crude rose above $103 following 28 attacks on commercial vessels in October, pushing freight costs to record highs. Ole Hansen of Saxo Bank noted that a break below $4,065 triggered consecutive stop-loss orders, while Roukaya Ibrahim of BCA Research stated the decline stemmed from cross-market liquidity strain. Neil Welsh of Britannia added that central banks continue to buy. The University of Michigan reported October consumer sentiment at 48.0, with one-year inflation expectations rising to 4.7% and long-term expectations reaching 3.5%. Technical indicators showed gold testing first support at $3,981 to $4,004.
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月26日上午，黄金交易价格在3996美元左右，跌破了4000美元的心理支撑位，当周收盘下跌超过3.5%。 霍尔木兹危机将布伦特原油推高至117美元上方，创下四年来的最高水平，加速了通货膨胀并对美联储维持利率不变施加了压力。 现货黄金收报每盎司3995.81美元。 10月份商业船只遭到28次袭击后，WTI原油升至103美元以上，将货运成本推至历史新高。 盛宝银行的奥le·汉森指出，跌破4065美元触发了连续的止损单，而BCA研究公司的鲁卡娅·易卜拉欣表示，下跌源于跨市场流动性压力。 不列颠公司的尼尔·韦尔奇补充说，各国的中央银行仍在继续购买。 密歇根大学公布10月份消费者信心指数为48.0，一年期通胀预期升至4.7%，长期预期达到3.5%。 技术指标显示黄金正在测试3981美元至4004美元的第一支撑位。

articles.headline: Dollar rises as markets eye central bank meetings
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: The dollar rose against major currencies including the euro, yen, and sterling on Tuesday as markets positioned themselves ahead of a series of central bank meetings, including the Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank, and the Bank of Japan, all expected to keep interest rates on hold. The euro fell 0.33% against the dollar to $1.1136 and was on track to be the worst-performing developed-market currency in October, down 1.70%, pressured by high energy costs, French bond volatility, and fiscal worries. Meanwhile, the euro extended its losses following the ECB's quarterly Bank Lending Survey, which showed the impact of rate hikes becoming visible. Convera FX and macro strategist Kevin Ford noted that the dollar rebounded ahead of the Fed meeting and AI sentiment stabilized following last week's selloff. Bank of America analysts led by Mark Cabana stated in a note that USD risks skew lower on a hold, with a dovish hold risking outsized USD weakness. Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama stated that the government stood ready to take decisive action in the currency market, while the yen strengthened around 0.75% on the dollar last week. The dollar index rose 0.27% to 102.29, and the Reserve Bank of New Zealand and Bank of Canada prepared to announce policy decisions where both are expected to raise interest rates.
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，美元兑欧元、日元和英镑等主要货币走势走高，市场正为美联储、欧洲央行和日本银行的一系列央行会议做准备，这三家央行预计均将维持利率不变。 欧元兑美元下跌0.33%至$1.1136，受高能源成本、法国政府债券波动及财政担忧拖累，10月份跌幅达1.70%，有望成为表现最差的发达市场货币。 欧洲央行公布的季度银行借贷调查显示加息影响显现后，欧元进一步小幅下跌。 Convera外汇与宏观策略师Kevin Ford表示，在美联储会议前美元有所反弹，人工智能情绪在上周抛售后也有所企稳。 以Mark Cabana为首的美银分析师在一份投资者报告中指出，维持利率不变时的美元风险偏向下行，鸽派按兵不动存在引发美元过度走弱的风险。 日本财务大臣片山皋月表示政府随时准备在外汇市场采取果断行动，日元上周兑美元走强约0.75%。 衡量美元对日元和欧元等一篮子货币汇率的美元指数上涨0.27%至102.29。 新西兰储备银行和加拿大央行也将在周三公布政策决议，两家央行均预计将提高利率。

articles.headline: U.S. stocks edge higher ahead of Federal Reserve decision on interest rates
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: U. S. stocks edged higher on Wednesday as markets awaited the Federal Reserve's interest rate announcement. The S&P 500 rose 0.1 per cent, the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 144 points or 0.3 per cent, and the Nasdaq composite fell by less than 0.1 per cent. Wall Street broadly expects the Fed to leave the federal funds rate unchanged after raising it last month, though focus remains on whether hints for future meetings will be given, with Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh previously adamant about giving fewer indications. Several companies rallied after beating summer profit expectations, including GE HealthCare Technologies which jumped 7.8 per cent and raised full-year financial forecasts, and Etsy which climbed 4.9 per cent as CEO Kruti Patel Goyal reported buyer and seller growth. Artificial intelligence stocks stabilized, boosted by South Korean memory chip seller SK Hynix soaring 10.9 per cent after reporting rising AI usage and expecting demand to outpace supply through 2030, while Micron Technology rose 4.4 per cent. Conversely, Boston Scientific fell 8.1 per cent on a lower current-quarter profit forecast, and Robinhood Markets sank 3 per cent on weaker quarterly profit and revenue. In bonds, the 10-year Treasury yield rose to 5.01 per cent from 4.99 per cent. International oil prices increased, with Brent crude climbing 1.8 per cent to US$111.33 per barrel amid Middle East uncertainty. Global markets also rose, led by South Korea's Kospi jumping 6.6 per cent.
articles.summary_zh: 美国股市周三小幅走高，市场正等待美联储当天下午的利率决定公告。 标普500指数上涨0.1%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨144点或0.3%，纳斯达克综合指数下跌不到0.1%。 华尔街普遍预期美联储将在上个月三年来首次加息后维持联邦基金利率不变，焦点在于是否会给出后续会议的线索，尽管美联储主席Kevin Warsh自上任以来一直坚持减少对未来行动的暗示。 多家公司因夏季业绩超出分析师预期而上涨，其中GE HealthCare Technologies大涨7.8%并上调了全年营收等财务预测，Etsy攀升4.9%，其首席执行官Kruti Patel Goyal称在线市场的活跃买家实现两年来首次同比增长。 人工智能股票表现稳健，韩国SK Hynix在发布利润报告后在首尔暴涨10.9%，该公司称正处于人工智能使用量上升的良性循环中，并预计2030年前需求将持续超过供应，Micron Technology则上涨4.4%。 相比之下，Boston Scientific因当前季度利润预测逊于预期而下跌8.1%，Robinhood Markets因利润和营收不及预期下跌3%。 债券市场上，10年期国债收益率从周二晚的4.99%升至5.01%。 受中东局势不确定性影响，国际油价上涨，布伦特原油价格上涨1.8%至US$111.33。 全球股市也随之走高，受SK Hynix暴涨带动，韩国Kospi指数领涨全球，大涨6.6%。
